Name: Spider 'Shrooms (Spider Replacer)
Author: popokoes
Description:
Inspired by @OsmiaCyril's [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/7477?tab=description]Spiders are Bears[/url] mod, this mod changes the spiders on floors 51-69 in the challenge version of the mines to purple mushrooms!

Arachnophobia friendly.

This mod does the following:
- Changes spider enemy textures in the challenge mode mines to purple mushrooms!
- Changes spiderweb textures in the challenge mode mines to orange leaves!

Requires Content Patcher.

Thank you OsmiaCyril for the inspiration!
